messages.subject: Swiftbox security questionnaire - item 12: third-party penetration testing
messages.body:
Dear Dev,

As promised during the SLA discussions, please find attached our standard security questionnaire ahead of the contract renewal. Most items are administrative and I expect straightforward answers.

Item 12 is the one I will flag in advance: we require evidence of a third-party penetration test, conducted by an external firm, covering your production environment, dated within the last twelve months. Internal testing, self-assessment, or a bug-bounty report will not satisfy the requirement — our auditor checks the attesting firm's credentials, not just the existence of a report.

Given your renewal cycle, we would need the report or a letter of engagement with a test date before we can progress the paperwork.

Kind regards,
Carla Dunne
Head of Operations, Swiftbox

messages.subject: RE: Swiftbox security questionnaire - item 12: third-party penetration testing
messages.body:
Carla,

Straight answer on item 12: we do not currently have a third-party pentest in the last twelve months. Internal reviews and the audit trail from our hosting migration, yes; an external attestation, no. I am not going to dress up our internal work to pass the item.

What I can commit to: engaging an external firm now, with the test completed and the report in your hands before your renewal paperwork needs to progress. Our internal practice is sound — the gap is the independent attestation, and that is a procurement exercise, not an engineering one.

I will come back with the firm and the test window this week.

Cheers,
Dev
Dev Raman | CTO | Parcelwise B.V.

messages.subject: RE: Swiftbox security questionnaire - item 12: third-party penetration testing
messages.body:
Dear Dev,

Thank you for the direct answer; item 12 disappointments are usually preceded by creative wording, so I appreciate its absence.

The timeline: our renewal paperwork must be finalised by mid-June. For the auditor's file we need either the final report or a signed engagement letter stating the test window by 15 June at the latest. A test conducted in June satisfies the requirement provided the engagement is documented beforehand.

Kind regards,
Carla Dunne
Head of Operations, Swiftbox

messages.subject: FYI: Swiftbox renewal now requires a third-party pentest - need budget
messages.body:
Helen,

Forwarding the exchange with Swiftbox below — their questionnaire requires a third-party pentest of our production environment, with a signed engagement by 15 June.

This is now a renewal condition for a solid mid-size account, and after the March key episode I would want one anyway. Can you pick a vendor budget line with me this week? I have two candidate firms and a rough idea of cost; the serious quotes should land by Monday.

Cheers,
Dev
Dev Raman | CTO | Parcelwise B.V.
